title: Professional Journey
paragraphs: I am a full-stack developer at inquirED, where I build and maintain MERN applications that deliver inquiry-based curriculum to educators and students across the United States.

My work spans modern cloud and delivery practices, including AWS services and CI/CD workflows with CodePipeline and CloudFront to support reliable deployments, performant delivery, and scalable architecture.

I focus on product quality through test automation and build user experiences that are responsive across desktop and mobile. I also prioritize accessibility, designing and implementing interfaces that are inclusive, usable, and aligned with best practices.
